name: NHS England — accessible information and reasonable adjustments
description: NHS England guidance on accessible information, communication support and reasonable adjustments for disabled people using health and adult social care services.
intended_use: Prepare for asking a health or care service in England about communication formats, extra time, quieter waiting arrangements or other disability-related access needs.
audience_or_context: Disabled people and people with impairments or sensory loss using NHS and publicly funded health or adult social care services in England, plus staff supporting access needs.
limitations: This records England guidance and standards; healthcare systems and implementation routes differ elsewhere in the UK.
What adjustment is appropriate depends on the person's needs and the service context.
This listing is not personalised legal or clinical advice.
cost_or_access_notes: NHS England guidance and accessible versions are publicly available online.
conflicts_of_interest: NHS England is the first-party standard-setting source for the NHS England route; ND Oracle does not determine an individual provider dispute.
